items.title: Sell your gold, silver and watches
items.body: We buy all gold, silver and other precious metals, jewellery in any condition, and pre-owned watches: chains, rings, odd earrings, broken pieces, old sovereigns. It is weighed and priced on the counter in front of you. Bring photo ID when you sell. Send a photo and a rough weight first if you would rather know before you travel.
sources: Instagram bio: We Buy All Gold & Jewellery
Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q14): watches, precious metals, photo ID needed
items.lead: Gold, precious metals and watches, any condition
points: Gold, silver and other precious metals, jewellery in any condition, pre-owned watches
Weighed and priced on the counter in front of you
Bring photo ID. Send a photo and a rough weight before you travel

items.title: Part-exchange
items.body: Put the value of gold or a watch you already own towards something in the case. Tell us what you have and what you are looking at, and we will work out the difference.
items.lead: Trade what you own against what you want
points: Gold or a watch you already own

items.title: Next-day delivery
items.body: Can't get to Cleethorpes? Next-day delivery is available nationwide, UK only, on pieces bought from the shop. Confirm timing for your address when you enquire.
sources: Instagram bio: Next Day Delivery Available
Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q7: nationwide next day, UK only)
points: On pieces bought from the shop
Confirm timing for your address when you enquire

items.title: Repairs and soldering
items.body: Jewellery repairs and soldering are done in the shop. Bring the piece in, or send a photo first, and you get a straight answer on what it needs and what it costs.
sources: Confirmed by Shaun for Tom, 3 Oct 2026: they also do jewellery repairs and soldering
Google review (Janice Skudder) mentions a repair done in under a week
items.lead: Jewellery repairs and soldering, done in the shop
points: Bring the piece in, or send a photo for a quote

items.title: Sourced or made to order
items.body: Not in the case? Tell us the piece you are looking for and we will source it. If it does not exist yet, we can make it to order. Tell us what you have in mind and we will come back with what is possible.
sources: Confirmed by Tom, 3 Oct 2026 (questionnaire Q5: we source pieces and we make to order)
